#nullable enable
using Etl.Core.Hosting;
using Xunit;
using LoadReferenceData.TestDoubles;

namespace LoadReferenceData.Tests;

public class RunAsyncTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task RunAsync_RollsBackAndNotifiesFailure_WhenTheRunCannotStart()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness();
        harness.ThrowOnGetBindToken = new InvalidOperationException("synthetic failure injected by RunAsyncTests");
        var package = harness.Package();

        var exitCode = await package.RunAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.Equal(ExitCode.LoadFailed, exitCode);
        var uow = Assert.Single(harness.CreatedUnitsOfWork);
        Assert.True(uow.RollbackCalled);
        Assert.False(uow.CommitCalled);
        Assert.NotNull(harness.Notifier.Result);
        Assert.False(harness.Notifier.Result!.Succeeded);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RunAsync_Succeeds_AgainstFakesWithNoFaultInjected()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness(useSampleDataForFileSources: true);
        var package = harness.Package();

        var exitCode = await package.RunAsync(CancellationToken.None);

        Assert.Equal(ExitCode.Success, exitCode);
        Assert.NotEmpty(harness.CreatedUnitsOfWork);
        Assert.All(harness.CreatedUnitsOfWork, uow =>
        {
            Assert.True(uow.CommitCalled);
            Assert.False(uow.RollbackCalled);
        });
        Assert.NotNull(harness.Notifier.Result);
        Assert.True(harness.Notifier.Result!.Succeeded);
        Assert.Empty(harness.Notifier.Result!.FailureHandlersRun);
    }
}
